items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Clyde. ... Joe would let him sing one number a night, and Clyde would have his book... He had his own music and everything. Joe didn't care if he didn't sing a lick! Yeah, he let him sing one number.

ctx.x: Because he was always getting bands together.
I know. He had bands. In fact, I think he used Chick Webb's band sometimes. And other little bands he'd play around with. I don't know, did Clyde work with him?
